services.name: HGV Category C1 training
services.summary: Practical training toward the Category C1 licence (medium-sized vehicles, 3.5t to 7.5t).

services.name: HGV Category C training
services.summary: Practical training toward the Category C (rigid lorry, over 3.5t) licence, including off-road and on-road tuition.

services.name: HGV Category C+E training
services.summary: Practical training toward the Category C+E (articulated lorry) licence for drivers who already hold Category C.

services.name: Category B+E (car and trailer) training
services.summary: Training toward the Category B+E licence for towing a larger trailer, caravan or horsebox behind a car.

services.name: Driver CPC periodic training
services.summary: Classroom Driver CPC periodic training (the 35 hours professional drivers renew every 5 years).

services.name: ADR (dangerous goods) training
services.summary: ADR training for drivers carrying dangerous goods, covering core and relevant class modules.

services.name: Forklift truck training
services.summary: Forklift truck operator training for workplace/warehouse handling (e.g. counterbalance and reach truck).

services.name: Driver medical (D4)
services.summary: D4 driver medical assessment required for HGV/PCV licence applications and renewals.
